output.source: Section121TwoPersons.income_excluded_from_gross_income (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:85, 250-254) with income_excluded_from_gross_income_uncapped (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:84, 219-224). Labels follow the cases of 26 U.S.C. 121: no_exclusion when (a) is not met or (b)(3) applies (uncapped amount $0); limited_to_250000 when the gain reaches the (b)(1) limitation; limited_to_500000 when it reaches the (b)(2)(A) limitation; entire_gain when the whole gain is excluded below the applicable limitation

exclusions.description: On a single return there is one taxpayer and the return carries one PersonalData, which the scope uses for both person 1 and person 2 (section_121.catala_en:95-105); a row whose person-2 labels differ from the person-1 labels describes no single return. Surviving-spouse returns are outside this exclusion: their person-2 labels describe the deceased spouse (CONVERSION.md sections 2 and 11)

notes: Sub-table 2 of 2 of US-121. Section121TwoPersons is the scope the official tests use; it has no (b)(2)(B) or (b)(4) rule (those are in Section121TwoPasses, whose PeriodMerge is a placeholder that returns [] and which no official test exercises), so a surviving spouse is treated like a single filer and a joint return that misses (b)(2)(A) gets the $250,000 limitation. On a surviving spouse's return the person-2 labels fill DeadSpouseInfo.death_spouse_info_at_time_of_death, the record that Section121TwoPasses passes as person 2 of a joint return evaluated at the date of death (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:399-421); Section121TwoPersons reads person 2 from DeadSpouseInfo.return (us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:105), so on those rows the output does not depend on the person-2 labels. REJECTED rows: any row in which a person whose data the scope reads has another section 121(a) sale raises the DateError of us_tax_code/section_121.catala_en:376 (US-121-1 notes). Corrected on 2026-10-20 (CONVERSION.md section 11).
